wishes.title: Custody of Child
wishes.content: If I die, I want my sister to raise my child, not my husband or his family.

wishes.title: Physical Contact Consent
wishes.content: If I am ever unconscious or in a coma, I do not consent to any non-medical physical contact from anyone other than my chosen guardian.

wishes.title: Organ Donation
wishes.content: If I am declared brain-dead, I consent to donating my organs, but only after my parents have been informed first.

wishes.title: Avoid In-laws Residence
wishes.content: If I am found in a situation where I cannot speak for myself, I do not want to be taken to my in-laws’ house under any circumstances.

wishes.title: Trusted Contact in Arrest
wishes.content: If I am ever arrested or detained, I want my trusted contact to be informed before anyone else.

wishes.title: Psychiatric Facility Consent
wishes.content: I do not consent to being placed in a psychiatric facility without a second independent medical opinion from a doctor I trust.

wishes.title: Female-led Assault Response
wishes.content: If I am sexually assaulted, I want a female police officer to take my statement and a woman doctor to conduct any medical examination.

wishes.title: Posthumous Rituals
wishes.content: In case of my death, I wish to be buried or cremated according to my stated personal beliefs, and not in any other way.

wishes.title: Restrict Location Sharing
wishes.content: If I am ever reported missing, I do not want my location shared with specific people I have listed.

wishes.title: Media Privacy After Death
wishes.content: I do not consent to any posthumous use of my photos or videos without my written permission during my lifetime.
